fact: DHIS2 states the project deploys climate tools on Malawi's DHIS2-based national health management information system (HMIS), with initial implementation in four districts.
The BMC Health Services Research article says data clerks transcribe patient records into facility registers that are compiled and reported via Malawi's DHIS1 electronic aggregation system.
The University of Malawi says HISP UNIMA is supporting the Ministry of Health in implementing DHIS2 systems and the national Health Management Information System (HMIS).
DHIS2 states Malawi's DHIS2-based national health information system, in use since around 2000, has incorporated a new NCD screening algorithm.
The DHIS2 profile says the Ministry of Health has used DHIS2 since 2012 as its HMIS, the main data collection tool and national repository for health data covering more than 60 health programs.
